question: implement and prove the Track 1 live-frame adapter path
verdict_meaning: LIVE_FRAME_ADAPTER_VERIFICATION is released by measurement and no longer blocks orders; B1 is the only blocker left. This means the live-frame path is wired and guarded OFFLINE. It does not mean Track 1 is ready to trade: no live day has been run and no broker has been connected.

providers.FrameBarProvider: deterministic, offline; used by every test and by shadow
providers.IBKRBarProvider: the real boundary; delegates to the runner's IBKRBroker rather than opening a connection, and refuses with no_broker when handed none. Never instantiated by route code in this stage.

task_b_wiring.candidates_refusal_reason: today's regime label, a cost object, and Calm A's true stop-risk sizing — inputs a live decision needs that this class must not invent

task_c_gate.detail: every live bar path on the route joins through track1_live_frame: track1_live_source (IBKRBroker, fetch_bars, fetch_session_bars, ib_insync, reqHistoricalData)
task_c_gate.why: a MEASURED_GATE re-runs on every read, so a fetch added later that skips the join shuts it again; CLOSED would freeze a verdict about code that can change

clock_contract.frozen_half: parquet stamps are UTC -> New York; Nikkei -> Asia/Tokyo
clock_contract.live_half: naive ET, the clock IBKRBroker.fetch_bars already produces
clock_contract.conversion: localize to America/New_York, then convert to the FROZEN FRAME's zone
clock_contract.target_read_from: the frozen frame, never a table

offset_is_not_constant.why: Japan keeps no summer time; the United States does

failures_the_join_alone_missed.evidence: reproduced Nikkei error refused; largest disagreement ~1035-1440 points

failures_the_join_alone_missed.caught_by: no bar may be stamped after the fetch instant
failures_the_join_alone_missed.evidence: the join accepted the whole shifted tail with code=ok before the check was added — found by running it, not by reading it

task_d_correctness.stated_limit: a multi-day live half shifted forward by less than its own span is caught by neither check; a session fetch is hours and a whole-zone error is 13-14, so the realistic case is covered. Pinned by a test that names the limit.
equivalence: MES cut/join reconstructs the original frame exactly
MNKD cut/join reconstructs the original frame exactly
Normal-R4 decisions identical on MES and on MNKD
Calm A decisions identical on MES
Calm A gate passes at 10:00 and refuses before it and on a hole
prior session's 15:59 bar survives the join byte for byte
Stress gate passes on 09:30-10:30 and refuses a hole and an unobserved window
duplicates / out-of-order / wrong tz / column mismatch all refuse
